summary: This well‑presented two‑bedroom ground‑floor apartment is situated within the popular Grange Court development in Carrville, offering modern, low‑maintenance living in a quiet and convenient residential setting.
description:
The property briefly comprises an entrance hall, open‑plan lounge/dining/kitchen with dual‑aspect French doors opening onto the communal gardens, two double bedrooms, and a family bathroom, along with an allocated parking space. Grange Court enjoys an excellent position within Carrville, a sought‑after suburb of Durham known for its strong community feel and easy access to local amenities. A range of everyday conveniences can be found nearby, including local shops and services on Carrville High Street, with further retail options available in the Belmont area and Durham City. The location also offers a good choice of cafés, takeaways, and restaurants. Transport links are a major advantage, with quick access to the A1(M) and A690, as well as frequent bus services providing a short and direct route into Durham City Centre. The area is well served by local schools, healthcare facilities, and leisure amenities, making it a practical and appealing place to live.

ENTRANCE HALL The entrance hall features laminate flooring, a central heating radiator, and provides door access to all rooms within the apartment.

OPEN PLAN LOUNGE / KITCHEN / DINING ROOM The spacious and well-presented open-plan lounge, dining, and kitchen area offers an excellent standard of modern living, with a versatile layout ideal for both relaxing and entertaining. The room is enhanced by attractive laminate flooring throughout, a radiator, and an abundance of natural light provided by dual-aspect uPVC-framed double-glazed French doors, which open directly onto the communal gardens, creating a bright and airy atmosphere. The kitchen area is thoughtfully designed and well-appointed, featuring a comprehensive range of fitted base and wall units offering ample storage, complemented by durable laminate work surfaces. An inset sink with drainer is set beneath a uPVC-framed double-glazed window, while tiling to the splashback and work areas adds both practicality and a clean, modern finish. Integrated appliances include an oven, hob, and extractor, making the space both functional and stylish for everyday use.

BEDROOM ONE Bedroom One is a well-proportioned and comfortable double room, featuring a UPVC-framed double-glazed window that allows for plenty of natural light, along with a radiator ensuring warmth throughout the year. The room offers ample space for a range of bedroom furnishings, creating a relaxing and inviting environment.

BEDROOM TWO Bedroom Two is another generously sized double room, featuring a UPVC-framed double-glazed window that provides good natural light, along with a radiator for year-round comfort. The room offers ample space for bedroom furnishings, making it both practical and versatile.

FAMILY BATHROOM

The bathroom is fitted with a modern white suite comprising a panelled bath with mains-fed shower over, wash hand basin, and low-level WC. Tiling to the splashback and vanity areas provides a practical and attractive finish, while a UPVC-framed double-glazed window allows for natural light and ventilation. A radiator completes the space, ensuring comfort and warmth.

EXTERNALLY Externally, the property benefits from well-maintained communal gardens, providing pleasant outdoor space for residents to enjoy. There is also the added advantage of an allocated car parking space, offering convenient and secure off-road parking.
